summary:
Results-driven Senior Data Scientist with 3+ years of experience delivering end-to-end AI/ML solutions. Proven
track record of architecting and deploying production-grade machine learning systems that deliver measurable
business impact — including a 92% accurate sales forecasting engine, a GenAI-powered student query system
that cut manual support workload by 48%, and an AI-driven LMS that boosted student engagement by 35%. Adept
at leading cross-functional teams, translating complex data into actionable insights, and scaling AI products from
prototype to production.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Scikit-learn→scikit-learn(100%), GenAI→Generative AI(100%), OpenAI GPT→GPT(100%), Google Gemini→Gemini(100%), REST APIs→REST API(100%)...)

bullets: Lead a cross-functional team of 4 (2 SDEs + 2 Data Scientists) to deliver end-to-end AI/ML solutions — from ideation and data analysis through to production deployment.
Architect predictive sales forecasting models by mining user behavioral patterns and seasonal trends, achieving 92% accuracy using XGBoost and LightGBM.
Oversee model development lifecycle including API integration and scalable deployment of AI products within LMS platforms.
Engineered a GenAI-powered Student Query Resolution System using LangChain and OpenAI GPT that reduced manual support workload by 48% and improved real-time response efficiency by 60%+.
Drove a 25%+ improvement in operational decision-making efficiency through AI-driven analytics dashboards and automated reporting pipelines.
Delivered production-ready ML models for Sales Forecasting, HR Analytics, Student Churn Prediction, and Course Recommendation, achieving up to 88%+ prediction accuracy using GBM and XGBoost.
Designed and deployed an AI-Powered Adaptive LMS integrating Transformer-based NLP, ANN architectures, and LangChain — increasing student engagement by 35% and learner completion rates by 32%+.
Built and optimized deep learning models (ANN, CNN, RNN, LSTM) on structured and unstructured datasets, yielding a 27%+ uplift in model performance.
Applied K-Means and Hierarchical Clustering for student and course segmentation, improving targeted engagement strategies and boosting retention rates by 18%+.
Reduced model training time by 33%+ and improved clustering efficiency by 24%+ through PCA-based feature optimization and dimensionality reduction.
Delivered 50+ live training sessions on Python, Data Science, ML, and AI using project-based learning methodologies.
Performed end-to-end data preparation — cleaning, transforming, and structuring educational datasets — improving data quality for student performance and course completion analysis.
Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) on student engagement and performance datasets to uncover learning patterns, dropout risks, and progress trends.
Supported development of ML models for student performance prediction and personalized course recommendations.
Collaborated cross-functionally with instructors and product teams to align data insights with curriculum design and learning outcomes.
Documented analytical findings and delivered weekly insight reports to senior management, enhancing data- driven decision-making.
